Embankment mapping
with LiDAR.

From drone-acquired point clouds to a georeferenced coastal embankment database. A field-to-analysis workflow combining LiDAR, RTK corrections, terrain modelling and segment-level geometry in southwestern Bangladesh.

The context

Making coastal defence measurable.

Coastal embankments protect settlements, livelihoods and agricultural landscapes across southwestern Bangladesh. Their condition, however, varies sharply over short distances. This work translates high-resolution UAV observations into consistent, measurable indicators of embankment geometry.

Developed under SURF-IT, the workflow produces elevation, crest-width and land- and river-side slope statistics for downstream embankment vulnerability assessment and tidal-surge early-warning research.

ProjectSURF-IT · Spatial Surge Forecasting Using AI and Community Knowledge
InstitutionNorth South University · Department of Environmental Science & Management
Research guidanceDr. Md. Farhadur Rahman
Primary toolsDJI Terra, CloudCompare, ArcMap, R / RStudio, RTK GNSS

The approach

One workflow, six stages.

Designed to connect field acquisition with reproducible geospatial outputs, the process moves from raw observations to corrected elevation surfaces and embankment-level indicators.

01—02

Capture & reconstruct

Drone LiDAR surveys, RTK reference observations, orthomosaics and point clouds in DJI Terra.

03—04

Clean & align

CloudCompare classification and rasterization, followed by DEM clipping, projection and mosaicking.

05—06

Correct & quantify

SRTM/RTK-based elevation offsets, cross-sections and segment-level slope, width and elevation statistics.

01 / FIELD DATA & RECONSTRUCTION

From flight missions to spatial data.

Field teams acquired drone LiDAR and imagery across planned grid areas, supported by RTK observations. DJI Terra was used to reconstruct orthomosaics and 3D point clouds while preserving the spatial reference needed for later processing.

UAV surveyRTK GNSSDJI Terra
DJI Terra / reconstruction
02 / POINT CLOUD PROCESSING

Separating terrain from surrounding objects.

LiDAR point clouds were inspected and cleaned in CloudCompare, removing vegetation, built structures and unwanted returns from the embankment surface. Cleaned clouds were rasterized with a 0.5 m grid step using median cell elevation, with gap-filling where appropriate.

CloudCompareLAS point cloudsRaster DEM
CloudCompare / point-cloud cleaning
03 / ELEVATION CORRECTION & GEOMETRY

Turning elevation surfaces into embankment metrics.

DEM tiles were corrected using elevation differences against reference data, RTK points, and neighbouring corrected tiles where direct control was missing. Using ArcMap and R, the embankment was divided into reporting segments, cross-sections were intersected with crest and toe lines, and per-segment statistics were compiled.

ArcMapR / terraCross-sectionsSlope & width
GIS / embankment delineation

Spatial deliverables

The terrain, made legible.

An analysis-ready segment database

The output connects corrected elevation surfaces with embankment geometry, resulting in 4,224 georeferenced segment records prepared for spatial vulnerability analysis.

The mapped elevation bands show spatial differences in crest height; these are descriptive quantiles, not flood-risk thresholds or verified safety categories.
MeasureWhat is calculated
ElevationMean, median, 20th/80th percentiles, minimum, maximum and variation
Crest widthDistance between land-side and river-side crest positions
River-side slopeSlope angle and percentage from crest to river-side toe
Land-side slopeSlope angle and percentage from crest to land-side toe
GeometryCross-section identification, segment ID and spatial reference

Under the hood

Methods built for reproducibility.

The processing workflow is documented through GIS field and processing instructions, alongside R scripts for elevation correction and embankment geometry extraction.

DEM_height_correction_manual.R

Elevation correction

Uses reference DEM offsets, RTK-derived elevation differences and overlap-based correction for neighbouring tiles without direct RTK observations.

  • Reference elevation comparison and outlier trimming
  • Median vertical offsets from RTK checkpoints
  • Alignment using overlapping corrected DEM tiles
dem_elevation_extraction_with_threshold.R

Segment geometry statistics

Samples corrected DEM elevations at top/toe intersection points and derives physically interpretable width and slope measurements.

  • River/land crest and toe elevation extraction
  • Cross-sectional width and slope calculations
  • Per-segment summaries with flagged gap filling

Supporting documentation: Drone Survey and Data Processing Manual, GIS & RS, covering field acquisition, DJI Terra, CloudCompare, ArcMap and raster-processing procedures.

Next steps

From mapped terrain to better early warning.

The resulting data help describe where coastal embankments vary in elevation and geometry, providing inputs for more detailed vulnerability and surge-impact assessment within SURF-IT.
